name: The Tome of Nobility

angles.text: As a paladin, this mark of favor honors your dedication to the brotherhood in Stormwind, granting you an unearned boon before harsher trials are set.

faq.answer: Duthorian Rall is a leader among the paladins gathered in Stormwind, guiding initiates and bestowing honors upon those who serve the Light.
Duthorian Rall can be found offering counsel and instruction in the city of Stormwind.
Duthorian Rall grants the boon freely for now in recognition of your devotion, though he intends to set a far sterner test for paladins who come after.
faq.q: Why is this gift offered without a trial?

sections.body: In the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall welcomes you as kin. Your continued dedication brings honor to every paladin of the Silver Hand, and he stands ready to bestow a great boon. Though a trial of greater hardship may await those who walk this path hereafter, he offers this token freely to honor your service.
sections.title: A Gift from the Order

summary: Duthorian Rall calls upon you in Stormwind to recognize your steadfast service among your fellow paladins. Having proven your devotion to the order, he prepares to confer a treasured gift upon you without trial.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Nobility
